useWhen: Establishing SEO foundation for new product launch

workflow.description: Research what people search for, search volume, and competition
Target keywords by stage, prioritize by opportunity, map to pages
Ensure site structure, crawlability, page speed, mobile-friendliness, schema
Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headers, content, internal linking
Plan what content to create, topics to cover, publishing cadence

examples.input: Set up SEO foundation for a B2B SaaS product that helps teams manage project workflows. Launch is in 3 months.
examples.output:
**SEARCH CONTEXT**

| Keyword | Monthly Searches | Competition | Priority |
|---------|----------------|-------------|----------|
| project management software | 74,000 | High | Long-term |
| team project management | 22,000 | Medium | Primary |
| workflow management tool | 14,800 | Medium | Primary |
| agile project management | 33,100 | High | Long-term |
| simple project tracker | 2,400 | Low | Quick win |

**KEYWORD STRATEGY**

| Stage | Keywords | Target Pages |
|-------|----------|--------------|
| Quick wins | "project tracker for small teams" | Landing page |
| Primary | "team project management" | Features page |
| Primary | "workflow management" | Use cases |
| Long-term | "project management software" | Blog, guides |

**TECHNICAL SEO**

| Check | Status | Action |
|-------|--------|--------|
| Site structure | OK | 3-click depth |
| Sitemap | Missing | Submit to Google Search Console |
| Page speed | Slow | Optimize images, lazy load |
| Mobile | OK | Responsive design |
| Schema | Missing | Add Organization + Product schema |

**ON-PAGE SEO**

| Page | Title Tag | Meta Description |
|------|------------|-----------------|
| Home | Team Project Management Software | Streamline your team's workflow... |
| Features | Project Management Features | See all features... |
| Pricing | Simple, Transparent Pricing | Start free... |

**CONTENT PLAN**

| Month | Content | Target Keyword |
|-------|---------|---------------|
| 1 | Guide: How to Choose Project Software | project management software |
| 2 | Blog: 5 Signs You Need Workflow Management | workflow management |
| 3 | Blog: Remote Team Best Practices | team project management |
